_note: Canonical sitting UI copy — the one source for every viewport (web, desktop, VS Code, TUI, CLI). Edit this file; nothing else. Served merged with user overrides at GET /api/ui-copy, and as a JS shim at GET /ui-copy.js (rendered from this file at request time, so there is no generated copy to drift). Python viewports read it through kettle.uicopy.

_fields.text: The string. Titles/heds: Title Case. Body copy and button labels: sentence case or lowercase per docs/UI.md.
_fields.short: Optional terse variant for a narrow surface (TUI status bar, a 2-line pane). Viewports prefer it when space is tight and fall back to text. Same meaning, fewer words — never a different instruction.
_fields.note: Where this string appears and what it is for. Written for a reader (human or agent) who has only the key.

chatPlaceholderProposing.text: Ask to revise the proposal — or edit it, then Found Desk

editorPlaceholderFounding.short: founding — work in the agent pane

editorPlaceholderProposing.text: Desk Proposal — edit, then use Found Desk
editorPlaceholderProposing.note: Editor placeholder when the Desk Proposal is the open document.

foundingQueueHintTitle.note: Queue empty-state hed during the founding interview.

foundingQueueHintBody.text: The curator is in the agent pane. Answer there, then Draft Proposal ✓ when ready. The queue fills after you use Found Desk on the proposal.
foundingQueueHintBody.short: Answer the curator in the agent pane, then Draft Proposal ✓.
foundingQueueHintBody.note: Queue empty-state body during founding — says where the work is and what fills the queue.

proposingQueueHintTitle.note: Queue empty-state hed while a proposal awaits Found Desk.

proposingQueueHintBody.text: Edit the proposal in the editor until it matches your project, needs, and expectations. Chat with the curator to revise or co-write. Press Found Desk only when it feels right — that founds the desk and stocks the first queue.
proposingQueueHintBody.short: Edit the proposal until it matches your intent, then Found Desk.
proposingQueueHintBody.note: Queue empty-state body while proposing. The short form is what a status bar shows.

noEntryBriefBody.text: The Kettle file panel contains a batch of files for you to review, edit, approve, and sweep when the batch is finished.
noEntryBriefBody.short: A batch of files to review, edit, approve, then sweep.
noEntryBriefBody.note: Second line of the Desk brief when a project is bound but no queue entry is selected.

queueTitle.note: Hed of the queue pane (left column, top).

metaTitle.note: Hed of the entry-metadata pane (left column, bottom).

metaEditLabel.note: Button in the Info pane hed that switches entry fields to editable.

deskProjectLabel.note: Label beside the project selector in the desk chrome.

approveLabel.note: Ritual button: bookmark a ruling on the open entry. Becomes approveLabelFounding while proposing.

approveLabelFounding.note: The same ritual button while a Desk Proposal is open — pressing it founds the desk (P4 → founded).

approveHint.text: Bookmark a ruling — does not apply or commit
approveHint.note: Tooltip on Approve. States what it does not do, which is the common misread.

approveHintFounding.text: Found this desk from your edited proposal
approveHintFounding.note: Tooltip on the ritual button while it reads Found Desk (proposing).

commentLabel.note: Ritual button: open the note box for the open file.

commentHint.text: Leave a note on this file for the agent to address during the sweep

commentTiedHint.text: tied to this file; the sweep reads it when it closes the sitting
commentTiedHint.note: Hint under the comment box, explaining when the note is consumed.

commentSaveLabel.note: Button that commits the comment box.

sweepHint.text: close the sitting — apply rulings, diff & assess the batch, fix/flag ripples, log the session, restock the queue
sweepHint.note: Tooltip on Sweep — the full list of what closing does.

foundingHeadTitle.note: Status strip under the project bar while the founding interview runs.

draftProposalLabel.note: Ends the interview early and drafts the Desk Proposal (P3 → P4). The ✓ is part of the label.

draftProposalHint.text: skip remaining chat and draft the desk proposal now

skipFoundingLabel.note: Leaves founding for later and opens the project as-is.

skipFoundingHint.text: leave founding for later — open the project as-is (no charter or queue yet); reselect it to resume founding
skipFoundingHint.note: Tooltip on skip for now. Names the cost (no charter, no queue) and how to resume.

sweepConfirmTitle.note: Hed of the sweep confirmation dialog.

sweepConfirmBody.text: Closes the sitting: applies ticked rulings (launches become logged directives), diffs and assesses every reviewed entry, fixes or flags ripples, writes the session log, and restocks the queue.
sweepConfirmBody.short: Applies rulings, assesses the batch, logs the session, restocks the queue.
sweepConfirmBody.note: Body of the sweep confirmation — the authoritative description of what a sweep does.

sweepThrustPlaceholder.text: a steer for this pass — what's most on your mind as you close the sitting. the agent reads it first (optional · ⌘Enter sweeps)
sweepThrustPlaceholder.note: Placeholder for the optional free-text steer on the sweep dialog.

addProjectNote.text: Name a folder under your home. The interview starts in the agent pane — Draft Proposal ✓ drafts a proposal you edit, then use Found Desk.
addProjectNote.short: Name a folder; the interview starts in the agent pane.
addProjectNote.note: Body of the add-project dialog — sets up what happens after Start Interview.

addProjectStart.note: Button that registers the project and opens founding (P1 to P3). Title Case: docs/UI.md lists it by name among the signature actions that are also titles, beside Found Desk and Draft Proposal. The web markup read 'start interview' until 2026-09-30, so the sitting and the VS Code mirror disagreed.

addProjectNamePlaceholder.note: Placeholder for the project's display name.

addProjectFoundingQuestion.text: In a sentence or two: what is this, and what do you want from a second reader here?
addProjectFoundingQuestion.short: What is this, and what do you want from a second reader?
addProjectFoundingQuestion.note: The one mission question of registration (P1). Founding is a conversation, not a confirmation card — see docs/REVIEW.md.

addProjectFoundingPlaceholder.text: e.g. a research folder that grows fast — flag anything that looks stale or contradicts what's already written

setupNote.short: Pick the agent CLI. Kettle never stores API keys.
